classification.difficultyReason: The student must recognise the tangent–chord angle and link it to the angle at the centre, or use a perpendicular radius and an isosceles triangle. That is two linked steps with the diagram given, which is routine development level.

answer.worked:
The radius is perpendicular to the tangent, and triangle $OTA$ is isosceles because $OT=OA$.
$$\begin{align*}\angle OTA&=90^\circ-35^\circ\\&=55^\circ\\a&=180^\circ-2(55^\circ)\\&=70^\circ\end{align*}$$
